encoding: two 6x7 planes: side-to-move and opponent occupancy
labels: realized terminal outcomes of completed heuristic-guided self-play trajectories; not exact game-theoretic values
target_scale: winner * side_to_move; -1 for realized loss, +1 for realized win, 0 for draw
split: 70/15/15 by source game after mirror canonicalization and global deduplication
duplicate_policy: deduplicate exact and horizontally mirrored encodings before splitting
inference_scale: tanh output in [-1,1], scaled by 100 in NeuralEvaluator, then multiplied by state.turn in API/tournament to obtain Red-perspective search value
dataset_generation: At each ply, choose a handcrafted-score greedy move with probability 0.7 and a random legal move with probability 0.3.
metadata_note: Recomputed from seeded game trajectories and the existing checkpoint; checkpoint was not retrained or replaced.
checkpoint_selection: final fixed epoch; validation and test metrics do not select or early-stop training
